content: The brand was established by José Pepin Garcia and is produced at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. Pepin specifically crafted the blend to replicate the cigars that he and his fellow rollers in Cuba traditionally smoked while working in the factories there. This particular brand incorporates a blend of Nicaraguan tobaccos for the filler, while the binder is also made from a Nicaraguan leaf. The wrapper is an oily, brown Corojo '99 leaf. The cigar is classified as medium-bodied. Its band is designed with simplicity, featuring a gold background with black lettering. The cigars are packaged in boxes containing 25 units each.
